name: Maia Sandu

name: Vasile Tofan
quote: Our task is to keep Moldova's European path irreversible while protecting citizens from the economic and security pressure of this moment.

name: Alexandru Munteanu

name: Igor Grosu
role: Speaker of the Parliament of Moldova
